description: Mixed-level LBF: 10x10 grid, 6 foragers at levels {1,1,2,2,3,3} and 5 food items at levels {1,2,3,4,2}. Level-1 food is collectable solo by any forager, level-4 food requires a coalition (e.g. 1+3 or 2+2 or 1+1+2), so the run exercises both solo and cooperative loads under the same coordination rule.
